posts.text:
when you’ve made the kind of mistake putin has made invading ukraine, you need a way to vote that leader out of office. 

zero accountability for that sort of failure is extremely dangerous.

iran war the biggest foreign policy mistake of trump’s presidency. 

but nothing close to putin’s decision to invade ukraine. that’s a failure of truly epic proportions. 

increasingly worries me, given that putin is not given to admitting mistakes.

as trump becomes more constrained on policy,
don't be surprised if he spends more time
making money.
@gzeromedia

Video
trump’s biggest foreign policy miscalculations have come from underestimating other countries; whether friends (ukraine), competitors (china), or adversaries (iran).

bill pulte? as director of national intelligence? 

you’ve got to be kidding me.
kinda disreputable pigeon has decided to say hi on my office windowsill.

the midterms are coming.
republicans will lose seats.
and trump knows it.
@gzeromedia

Video

on china and iran, trump has a big punch but a glass jaw.
and now he’s backing down.
talking about the patterns of trump’s foreign policy with @ezraklein

the biggest source of geopolitical uncertainty
is also the world’s most powerful country.

not a great combination.
